sampled_supersession_rate.caveat: One month of official query bytes. It indicates an order of magnitude, not a retention guarantee and not a rate that can be assumed constant across 60 months.

why_the_bulk_archives_cannot_answer_this.detail: In the recovered pair the preserved-hash annual bulk archive holds only the later disclosure. A catalog built from bulk archives therefore cannot even detect that an earlier version existed.
why_the_bulk_archives_cannot_answer_this.materiality: The correction swapped parent and non-controlling interest amounts, so using the later version before its publication would leak information into the cutoff.
